newsitem.title: JAPAN: Optic fibre loop to connect U.S., Japan.
newsitem.headline: Optic fibre loop to connect U.S., Japan.

text.p: Japan and the United States will be connected by a 25,000 km-long submarine optic fibre cable system on December 31, international phone operator Kokusai Denshin Denwa Co said on Thursday.
Earlier this year, KDD and 78 global operators completed the construction of the northern route of the cable.
The firms will connect the northern route with the southern route -- which has been in use since December 1995 -- in December, KDD said.
The network, called Trans-Pacific Cable 5, will have a capacity of 10 giga bps, equivalent to about 120,000 telephone lines, KDD said.
